calibration_review.recommendation: Return c2 for redraw. Do not treat it as a complete walk candidate and do not batch-generate or integrate it.
calibration_review.coordinate_convention: Absolute source pixels; bbox right/bottom exclusive. root x follows pelvis projection; root y follows supporting sole. foot marks one visible sole contact point.
visual_observations: The targeted edit did not repair the missing opposite half-cycle. Poses 1/4/5/8 remain broad contact/extended-stride variants, poses 2/6 remain a similar rear-foot recovery, and poses 3/7 remain a similar front-knee lift. Eight occupied cells represent approximately three gait classes, not eight valid alternating phases.

The near/far legs do not clearly exchange their weight-bearing and recovery roles across the second half. The extended pose returns after a knee lift and repeats, so ordering the cells cannot establish a complete alternating walk. Do not repair this by programmatic warping or mirroring a painted pose.

Torso, sword and free-arm motion stay small and nearly static. Lower-row body/leg extents are slightly taller than upper-row, and c2 is slightly larger than c1 under the same source-to-output scale. Loop, weight transfer and foot sliding remain unapproved.

Basic identity cues persist: silver hair with visible red forelock, black long coat with red lining, chest buckles, double red forearm wraps, dark segmented greaves. This does not establish G1/G2 or weapon-proportion acceptance.

The katana appears broadly similar to c1; c1 had an approximately 104-pixel guard-to-tip length against standard A7 128 px at 190-pixel actor scale. C2 has not been assigned validated weapon landmarks and no correction is claimed.
rectangular_crop_blockers: Pose 5 meaningful alpha>16 bbox [43,513,422,989] and pose 6 bbox [419,513,765,986] overlap in x. Their different vertical shapes are separable by a manual source mask or redraw, but no such operation is performed here.

The preserving bboxes for poses 5/6 include small fragments of the neighboring pose and intersect those fragments at alpha up to 249. allow_edge_alpha=false is deliberate for these two poses so the current crop-only tool refuses accidental export. Do not override as low-alpha noise.
calibration_review.required_next_source_change: Create the missing opposite-leg contact/down/passing/up half with explicit near-leg/far-leg labels and adequate transparent gutters. Re-review actual gait phases before treating the eight-cell sheet as a loop.

walk.loop_review: Requested cyclic review only. C2 is rejected as a complete cycle because the opposite half-step is missing; loop=true expresses desired playback semantics, not an acceptance result.
